reason: Nobody in my IELTS Telegram chats has mentioned it yet, so I'd just use the free 3 fragments a day in the marshrutka and see if it actually works. Pronunciation alone isn't my main IELTS problem, so I won't pay for it on day one.
objection: These apps usually don't hear me properly with marshrutka noise, or they give random scores. If the score per sound is wrong, the explanation in Russian is useless, and $5 a month is real money for me.
would_change_my_mind: A few people in the IELTS Telegram group saying it really helped their Speaking band, and the free tier working well on my phone in a noisy place.
